## Bridger Aerospace Announces Schedule for its Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 29, 2026 4:05pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_36925f0ef07bad6b9737367b397082c0/bridgeraerospace/news/2026-10-29_Bridger_Aerospace_Announces_Schedule_for_its_96.pdf)


BELGRADE, Mont., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. (“Bridger” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: BAER, BAERW), one of the nation’s leading aerial firefighting companies, today announced that it will release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, November 16, 2026, after the market close.


Management will conduct an investor conference call on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (3:00 p.m. Mountain Time) to discuss these results and business outlook. Interested parties can access the conference call by dialing 1-800-343-4849 or 1-203-518-9848. When prompted, please provide the Conference ID: BRIDGER. **About Bridger Aerospace**
Based in Belgrade, Montana, Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. is one of the nation’s largest aerial firefighting companies. Bridger provides aerial firefighting and wildfire management services to federal and state government agencies, including the United States Forest Service, across the nation, as well as internationally.
